url.description: Where the tables go: s3://bucket/prefix, or file:// and an absolute path. Each stream's table is a directory of Parquet files under it.

endpoint.description: An S3-compatible endpoint, for stores other than AWS. Uses path-style addressing.

accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key. Without one, the AWS default credentials.

fileSize.description: Bytes a file reaches before the next one starts.
